10 COMMON SUPERSTITIONS
FOUR LEAF CLOVER
Finding a clover with four leaves is lucky because clovers usually only have three
leaves.
CAREFUL WITH THAT MIRROR
If you break a mirror, you will have seven years of misfortune.
KEEP THEM CROSSED
Crossing your index and middle finger is lucky because it symbolizes the support
between two friends.
FALLING LEAVES
If you catch falling leaves in autumn, every leaf you catch means a lucky month
next year.
BLACK CATS
You're in luck if you meet a black cat. However, that depends on who you ask —
some say it’s a sign of good-things to come, but for-others, it’s a terrible warning.
DON’T WALK UNDER A LADDER
This superstition is practical because walking under a ladder, possibly with
someone on it, is already a risky thing to do.
HORSESHOE
, Hanging a horseshoe over a door is lucky. But the horseshoe needs.to be the right
way up with the two ends pointing down so that the good fortune will shower upon
you.
NO UMBRELLAS INSIDE
Opening an umbrella indoors brings bad luck and danger — you might just poke
someone’s eye out.
MIND THE SALT
Spilt the salt? Oh, no! If you have, you must throw some over your shoulder to
counteract the bad luck, but make sure it is the left one.
. THERE GOES A MAGPIE
It’s bad luck to see one magpie, but it’s lucky to see two.
